dict.approvalRiskNotice:
The agent can access only apps you approve, and can read and control them in the background.

Online games, messaging apps, and other apps may restrict automation. Violating their rules could result in your account with that app being suspended or banned.

Proceed at your own risk. To stop automated control at any time, press Stop in DeepSeek Harness.
dict.title: Authorize computer use
dict.applicationsTitle: Manage applications computer use can access
dict.windowsSetupBody: Unlock the Windows desktop, then check again. DSH asks before accessing each application.
dict.windowsSessionUnknown: No interactive Windows desktop was verified. Run DSH in a signed-in desktop session, then check again.
dict.windowsCaptureUnavailable: This Windows session does not support window capture. Check the Windows version and graphics driver, then check again.
dict.windowsInstructions: Keep the Windows desktop unlocked. Some input needs the target application in front. Applications running with higher privileges can refuse access.
dict.windowsDesktopUse: An unlocked desktop is required for observation and input.
dict.elevated: The native component is running with administrator privileges.
dict.standardPrivileges: The native component is running with standard user privileges.
dict.setupTitle: Set up computer use before use
dict.setupBody: computer use is enabled. Before using it, switch to PTC mode and grant Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions. Open the plugin details to complete setup.
dict.setupQueryFailed: computer use is enabled, but system permissions could not be checked. Open the plugin details to see the error and retry.
